notes.title: DEMO version has been updated to v0.10.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, fellow players!
It's been a long time, and I'm here with a big update to the DEMO version, and I hope you like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
[b]1. New costumes[/b]
This time we have added a black leather outfit for our archer character, with the possibility of changing outfits each time we respawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/e53afd264a2a7d3f782befb1a3c2bbedb15fca72.gif[/img]

[b]2. Replacement arrows, replacement God's wish actuality and a lot of UI updates[/b]
The previously revealed arrow replacement, wish skill and wish skill replacement have all been installed.
Now more than one wish skill can be used at the same time, and you can still get a wish when using a wish skill.
In addition, this update refurbished a large number of UI interfaces.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/e37339344c0cabb3b72717df6a800ae8afdda2f5.gif[/img]


[b]3. Game display optimization and performance optimization[/b]
This update optimizes the lighting, terrain, level layout, vegetation performance and many visual effects.
In addition, a runtime test of the game after tuning shows that the frame rate of the default effect has been improved by at least 30%.

[b]4. Arrow Pouch and Book of Experience[/b]
New pickup items arrive, including the Arrow Pouch and Book of Experience.
Picking up an arrow pouch will give you access to a package of arrows.
Picking up the Book of Experience can add a lot of experience value.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b236f96c817c1d039dd5dd0b39d746a711b8b6fb.gif[/img]

Finally, this update adds Japanese and Russian language support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
Hope you like it, any questions welcome in the Steam forum or Discord channel feedback.

notes.title: Feature Express [2022 New Year]
notes.content:
Happy New Year 2022, fellow players!
I'm here with the latest features of the dev version, hope you like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
[b]God's Wishes can now be displayed in the UI by selecting multiple as well as arrows[/b]
The current demo's wish portal is hard to find. At the same time, many players have reported that they don't know how to switch between multiple wishes. This change puts the arrow and godwish toggle buttons in a very prominent place and displays the set godwish skill buttons together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/7b5c15217ca20a7554449436340f6471e2b4f4ef.gif[/img]

[b]The quick selection screen for God's Wish[/b]
As with arrows, the order of the buttons can now be arranged by simply dragging and dropping the godwish cards. You can also see the introductory information and common attributes of the God's Wish on the left side of the configuration screen.

[b]Wishes are continuously acquired[/b]
Wishes are now continuously acquired while the player is alive. It no longer stops gaining Godwishes after using the Godwish skill, meaning combat will be easier!

[b]Wish Skills Overhaul[/b]
Wish skills can now be activated at the same time, and the number of wishes consumed varies from one wish skill to another. In addition, the cooldown time of the wish skills also varies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/e4c10b6d6eeacfc76a2163f78ae3487a6cf5e085.gif[/img]

[b]More Other[/b]
Some other issues have been revised and visual updates have been made this time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
Thanks again for following Archero, and let us know in Discord if you have any questions, suggestions, or ideas!
[url=https://discord.gg/3FHXJrPYCa][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/698f0d459a0b45bab7e1f32329c142c7d2c735ab.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Feature Express (21-12-11)
notes.content:
Hello everyone I'm wzspdw and I'm happy to show you some of the latest features of the game.

This presentation is about the new arrow type ---- Heavy Hammer Arrow. These arrows have unparalleled pounding power and can knock out small targets on hit instantly! Note that it doesn't matter if the target is normal, elite or leader, as long as it is a small unit it will be knocked out, just for a different length of time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/7554d95477bfb936b3d9d707be7f393574370022.gif[/img]

On top of that, this arrow does not penetrate armor, but has decent armor destruction and can effectively deal a lot of damage to the target's armor.
However, this arrow is not available early in the game, and it is so heavy that it cannot fly at high speeds and is slightly less accurate than other arrows. But, what the heck, it'll knock the enemy to the ground, right?

In addition to the new arrow types, we now have the ability to change arrow type equipment in each level live. 
In the Dress Up panel you can see each type of arrow card that is already visible and the properties of those arrows. And click to take the card and drag it to the card slot to equip that arrow type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/385860eef56caaa43a2674ee3322326249895135.gif[/img]

Of course, it is also possible to unequip a card equipped in a slot by clicking and dragging it out.

Well, that's all the features we've been able to reveal to you, and if you want to learn more, feel free to join our Discord channel! Stay tuned for more Archero features and updates.

notes.title: DEMO version has been updated to v0.8.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
Based on feedback from some players about performance and other issues to make an emergency update, the features of this update are as follows:
1.Adjust the rendering settings -- global reflections are only enabled at the most advanced level
2.Anomaly cube removal - bug fix
3.Fix the draw animation for all bows -- animation patching
El juego se encuentra actualmente a un 30% de progreso en general, estamos puliendo la sensación de la acción y añadiendo constantemente nuevos contenidos.
5.Slowing down the passage of time - reducing performance overhead
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/4c707c9c68a6d3f8259a5cf352d4ad53dd10946a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]

notes.title: DEMO Version Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
After a break due to the flu, production resumed on the new version. We have also updated the DEMO version, which has the following features.
1.DEMO package size reduction - 42% smaller than the first version
2.Archery dead spots are now removed - improving the smoothness of the game
3.New aiming collimation model replaces decals - easy to identify collimation
4.There is now a clear cue before the enemy comes - this cue is added after the countdown ends
5.Terrain, path adjustment - terrain is much better than before
6.Enemy count adjustment - slight difficulty pacing adjustment
7.Fixed auto-attack when God's Gift is selected - bug routine fix
8.SSGI\RTXGI support - for Nvidia 10-series or higher graphics cards, DX12 computers with rendering cranked up to enable GI functionality
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/53012e6c3440af22a0b9fe760bf126f0d22e48ec.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
